statement: Text search trims the query and matches title and photographer case-insensitively, so "  harbor " finds "Old Harbor Light".

faults.description: Query is no longer trimmed, so a query with surrounding spaces matches nothing.
Title is compared without lowercasing, so a lowercase query no longer matches a capitalized title.

statement: With tags active a card is kept only if it carries all of them, and the tag filter combines with the search filter by AND.

faults.description: AND semantics become OR (some), and with no active tags every card is dropped.
Search and tag filters are combined with OR instead of AND.

statement: Title sort is ascending with year ascending as tiebreak, and year sort is newest first with title as tiebreak.

faults.description: Title sort loses its year tiebreak, so cards with equal titles keep input order.
Year sort becomes oldest first instead of newest first.

statement: Toggling a valid card's favorite adds or removes it without error, the "Favorites: K" text counts exactly the favorited cards, and the toggle button's aria-pressed reflects favorite state.

faults.description: Adding a favorite calls a nonexistent method on a Set, so toggling a valid card throws a TypeError.
The favorites count is overstated by one, without any error.
Each card's aria-pressed shows the opposite of its favorite state, without any error.

statement: Toggling an id that belongs to no card is rejected with UnknownCardId, and toggling never mutates the input set.

faults.description: The unknown-id check is removed, so unknown ids are silently added to the favorites.
The function edits and returns the caller's own set instead of a copy.

statement: A card is accepted only with a non-blank trimmed title and photographer and an integer year within 1826 to 2026 inclusive; otherwise it is rejected with InvalidCard.

faults.description: The year upper bound becomes exclusive, so 2026 is wrongly rejected.
Whitespace-only strings are no longer treated as blank, so a title of spaces is accepted.

statement: Each card renders its title, "by <photographer>" and a four-digit year, and two cards sharing an id are rejected at load with DuplicateCardId.

faults.description: Seen ids are never recorded, so duplicate ids are never detected at load.
The rendered year is off by one.
The photographer template literal is unterminated, which is a syntax error that stops the module loading.
